_comment: Every value here is a placeholder. Point `root` and the path templates at your own
recordings, list your session ids, and leave block_overrides empty unless you have
cleaning corrections that the block manifests themselves do not carry.
The config used for the dissertation is not published: it describes human-subject
recordings collected under UCL ethics approval Project ID 2758, whose consent does
not extend to publishing the dataset. See the README section on participant data.
_block_overrides_comment: Per-session, per-block corrections applied on top of the manifest.
Use only for things a human decided while cleaning: a block window the automatic
segmentation got wrong, a label the protocol sheet disagrees with, or a quality tier
downgraded after review. Each key is optional.
label   : one of flexion | extension | left_bend | right_bend | left_twist | right_twist
window  : [start_s, end_s] in mocap time, overriding the manifest window
sig     : flex | lat | axial, overriding the channel derived from the label
sign    : +1 or -1, overriding the direction derived from the label
_sign_overrides_comment: Keyed 'session:block_id'. Use 0 to disable direction filtering for a block whose sign convention could not be established.
_unavailable_sessions_comment: Sessions that exist as recordings but are excluded from analysis, mapped to the reason.
Analysis scripts write this straight into their run manifest, so the exclusion is on the
record rather than showing up as a silently smaller cohort.

unavailable_sessions.S03: unconfirmed sensor placement and no paired mocap; fail-closed

_sflp_fallback_comment: Sessions whose on-chip SFLP quaternion stream is unreliable, and the check that decides
whether to fall back to the VQF filter:
bend_quat_finite : sacrum->upper quaternions are structurally broken (non-finite or zero-norm)
twist_variance   : quaternions are well-formed but frozen, carrying no information
Omit a session to always trust its SFLP stream.
